blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Coding agents are increasingly deployed for iterative development on real repositories, yet existing evaluation barely answers a basic question: do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel? The question matters: every duplicated implementation is a fix applied twice and agents produce code far faster than humans can audit, so redundancy accumulates unsupervised. Thus, we present RepoReuse , a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories, where requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns. It is built by a fully automated pipeline combining AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories. Beyond pass rates, we measure the reuse rate together with recall and cross-turn structural redundancy. An audit over 3,000 turns shows that agents progressively stop exploring relevant repository code, reuse their own history less even when it is fully in the workspace, and leave duplicated logic in 50.8% of task chains by turn 5—all while pass rates barely move. Such deficiencies are invisible to pass rates, underscoring the need to evaluate code generation beyond functional correctness.
blocks.zh: 编码剂被越来越多地用于在真正的寄存器上进行迭代开发,然而现有的评价却勉强回答了一个基本的问题:编码剂是重新使用现有的编码还是重新发明轮子? 问题事项:每一次重复执行都是两次应用的固定,代理生成的代码远快于人类可以审计,因此冗余积累无监督. 因此,我们提出RepoReuse,这是审计真实储存库中代码再利用的多回合基准,其中要求逐个披露,工作空间跨个回合累积。 它由一个完全自动化的管道建造,将基于AST的依赖性图表、指导性证据收集、执行核实任务综合以及易于到新储存库的尺度结合起来。 除了通过率之外,我们还衡量再利用率以及召回率和跨转结构冗余率。 超过3 000个回合的审计表明,代理商逐渐停止探索相关的存储码,即使在完全进入工作空间时也减少重复使用自己的历史,在50.8%的任务链中留下重复的逻辑,直到第5回合,而通过率几乎不变动。 这种缺陷对于通过率来说是看不见的,突出表明除了功能正确性外,还需要评价代码生成.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Coding agents continue to break records on coding benchmarks ( Team et al., 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and are increasingly deployed in real repositories to assist humans with iterative development. Yet passing tests is only half of what makes code good. Code is read, extended, and maintained long after it is written; a solution that reinvents the wheel is not a good solution, even when every test is green.
blocks.zh: 编码剂继续打破编码基准记录(Team等人,2026年;DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年;Yang等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年a;Jimenez等人,2024年),并越来越多地部署在真实的储存库中,以协助人类迭代发展. 然而,通过测试 仅仅是一半 使代码好。 代码在写成之后很长一段时间就被读取,扩展,维护;一个重塑车轮的解决方案不是一个好的解决方案,即使每个测试都是绿色的.

blocks.en: Motivation Redundancy is not a cosmetic issue. Over time, every duplicated implementation means a bug fix or an interface change that must be applied twice, a piece of functionality that silently drifts between parallel copies, and more code that every later turn—human or agent—must wade through. Recent studies have already observed the signs: in long-horizon iterative tasks, the redundancy of agent-produced code keeps rising, and agent-generated patches are markedly longer than reference solutions that reuse existing modules ( Orlanski et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Abbassi et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . What is truly alarming is the asymmetry of speed: agents write code far faster than human experts can audit it, so this failure mode accumulates at a staggering rate, quietly piling up into “spaghetti code.”
blocks.zh: 动机 裁员不是一个化妆品问题。 随着时间的推移,每一次重复执行都意味着一个必须两次应用的bug修正或接口更改,一个在平行副本之间悄悄漂移的功能部分,以及以后每一个人或代理人都必须经过的更多代码. 最近的研究已经观察到这些迹象:在长距离迭代任务中,由剂产生的代码的冗余不断上升,而由剂产生的补丁明显长于重复使用现有模块的参考解决方案(Orlanski等人,2026年;Li等人,2026年;Abbassi等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年)。 真正令人震惊的是速度的不对称:特工们写代码的速度远远快于人类专家能够审计它的速度,因此这种故障模式以惊人的速度累积,悄悄地堆积成“spaghetti代码 ” 。 “

blocks.en: Yet our evaluation instruments are, in principle, blind to all of this. Existing benchmarks are built almost entirely around functional correctness: HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) , and SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) score only whether tests pass (i.e., the pass rate), paying little attention to another key dimension of how models write code— reusability . Prior work touches on this dimension but does not measure it in realistic multi-turn, repository-scale development: benchmarks on reuse and maintainability either iterate only at the function level ( Wang et al., 2026 ) or are confined to a single turn ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , while repository-level efforts stop at one-shot completion or well-documented entry points rather than the discovery and reuse of internal modules ( Ding et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 然而,我们的评估工具原则上对这一切视而不见。 现有基准几乎完全以功能正确性为基础: HumanEval (Chen et al., 2021), MBPP (Austin et al., 2021), SWE-bench (Jimenez et al., 2024) 评分只有测试是否通过(即通过率),很少注意模型如何写代码的另一个关键方面——可重复性. 先前的工作触及这一层面,但并未以现实的多回合、储存规模的开发来衡量:关于再利用和可维护性的基准要么只在函数层面(Wang等人,2026年),要么限于单回合(Wang等人,2025年b年b年),而储存一级的努力则停留在一枪完成或有详细记录的进入点,而不是内部模块的发现和再利用(Ding等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年;Tang等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Real iterative development unfolds precisely at the repository scale, across turns: a model must keep developing on an existing multi-file repository, reusing existing code —not only the repository’s own modules, but also the code it wrote in previous turns, which has by then become part of the repository. To this end, we construct RepoReuse , a multi-turn benchmark for auditing code reuse in real repositories (See Figure 1 ). Requirements are revealed turn by turn and the workspace accumulates across turns, so that an agent’s reuse of both pre-existing repository modules and its own historical implementations can be measured turn by turn. RepoReuse is built by a fully automated pipeline that combines AST-based dependency graphs, guided evidence collection, and execution-verified task synthesis, and scales readily to new repositories ( Le et al., 2026 ; Jain et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 真正的迭代开发正是在寄存器规模上展开的,横跨:一个模型必须不断在现有的多文件寄存器上开发,重新使用现有的代码——不仅是寄存器自己的模块,还有它在之前的转存器中写的代码,到那时它已经成为寄存器的一部分. 为此,我们构建了一个多回合基准RepoReuse,用于审计在真实储存库中重新使用代码(见图1)。 要求依次显示,工作空间依次累积,这样可以依次衡量代理人对先前储存单元的再利用情况及其历史执行情况。 回收利用由一个完全自动化的管道建造,该管道将基于AST的依赖性图表、指导性证据收集和执行核实任务综合,以及易于到新储存库的尺度(Le等人,2026年;Jain等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Our metrics mirror the agent’s per-turn workflow: reading code, deciding what to reuse, and writing new code. The central metric, reuse rate , asks whether the submission calls each target through a real call edge, identified by AST analysis against the reference solution’s actual dependencies; repository and self-produced targets are measured separately ( reuse repo \text{reuse}_{\text{repo}} / reuse self \text{reuse}_{\text{self}} ). To explain why a target is missed, upstream recall records the fraction of target source code read in the current turn, separating exploration-side gaps (never read) from execution-side gaps (read but not used); downstream, C dup C_{\text{dup}} counts targets that are not called yet have most of their logic rewritten, capturing the redundancy they leave behind ( Jiang et al., 2007 ) . Together, the three trace a reuse decision from exploration to consequence, forming a complete auditing instrument for code reuse.
blocks.zh: 我们的衡量标准反映了代理商的每回合工作流程:读取代码,决定使用什么,以及写出新的代码. 中心度量,再利用率,询问提交是否通过真实的调用边缘调用每个目标,由AST分析根据参考解决方案的实际依赖性确定;寄存器和自制目标分别测量(再利用 repo\text{ reuse\\text{repo\\/再利用自\text{reuse\text{self})。 为了解释为何一个目标被错过,上游召回记录了目标源代码在当前转折时读取的一小部分,将探索-侧缺口(从未读过)与执行-侧缺口(读过但未被使用);下游,C dup C_{\text{dup}}}} 计数了尚未被调用的目标大部分逻辑重写,捕捉它们留下的冗余(Jiang等人,2007年). 这三个人共同追踪从勘探到后果的再利用决定,形成用于代码再利用的完整审计工具。

blocks.en: With this auditing instrument, we uncover systematic reuse deficiencies of coding agents. On the exploration side, agents gradually stop retrieving as turns progress: they read 83.6% of relevant repository code at turn 1 on average, but only 35.4% at turn 5. Once the workspace is filled with their own code, reuse decisions are increasingly made from signatures and priors rather than grounded in current-turn observation. On the execution side, a more counterintuitive phenomenon is that seeing is not using: recall over their own historical code is nearly saturated in every turn, yet self-reuse still decays from 83.9% to 69.1%. Ablations further show that disclosing the complete source of historical implementations barely helps, performing on par with providing no memory at all—the bottleneck is not access to information, but the agent’s own disposition to build on existing code. Downstream, bypassed targets steadily accumulate as structural redundancy in the workspace: the fraction of task chains containing a cross-turn re-implementation climbs from 13.8% at turn 1 to 50.8% at turn 5, while pass rates barely move. Agents solve task after task correctly while the codebase grows messier turn after turn, pass-rate-centered evaluation is structurally blind to all of it.
blocks.zh: 通过这个审计工具,我们发现了编码剂的系统性重复利用缺陷。 在勘探方面,物剂逐渐停止作为转弯进展的检索:它们平均读取了83.6%的相关寄存器代码第1转,但只有35.4%在第5转. 一旦工作空间被自己的代码填充,重复使用的决定就越来越多地由签名和前科作出,而不是以当前转弯观测为基础。 在行刑方面,一个比较反直觉的现象是,看不是在使用:回顾他们自己的历史代码几乎每一次都是饱和的,然而自我重复使用仍然从83.9%衰落到69.1%。 更进一步地显示,披露历史执行的完整源头几乎毫无帮助,其表现与完全不提供记忆一样 -- -- 瓶颈不是获取信息,而是代理商自己愿意在现有代码的基础上更上一层楼。 下游,被绕过的目标随着工作空间的结构冗余而稳步积累:包含交替重施任务链的一小部分从第1转折时的13.8%攀升到第5转折时的50.8%,而通过率几乎没有变化. 代理在任务完成后正确地解决任务,而代码库在转弯后会变得更混乱,而以过速率为中心的评价在结构上对它都视而不见.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • An important question: we raise a question neglected by existing evaluation: do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel? We give the first systematic, turn-by-turn measurable answer: agents steadily accumulate redundant code that piles up into “spaghetti code.” • The RepoReuse benchmark: a repository-level multi-turn iterative development benchmark with turn-wise requirement revelation, measuring an agent’s reuse of both pre-existing repository code and its own historical code turn by turn. It is built by a fully automated pipeline that requires no human involvement and scales readily to new repositories. • Auditing findings: a systematic audit over 3,000 turns of development shows that reuse deficiencies are pervasive and deepen over turns: agents see their own historical code yet fail to reuse it (self reuse decays from 83.9% to 69.1% even under saturated recall); by turn 5, half of the task chains have accumulated cross-turn re-implementations while pass rates barely move—deficiencies entirely invisible to pass-rate-centered evaluation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下: 一个重要问题:我们提出一个被现有评价忽略的问题:编码剂是重新使用现有代码还是重塑轮子? 我们给出了第一个系统化的、逐个转弯的、可衡量的答案:特工们不断积累冗余代码,堆积成“spaghetti代码”。 RepoReuse基准:一个存储器层面的多回合迭代发展基准,并按转机要求披露,测量一个代理对先前存在的存储器代码的再利用情况,以及它自己的历史代码逐个转弯。 它由一个完全自动化的管道建造,它不需要人的参与,其规模可以随时提供给新的储存库。 • 审计结果:对3 000个发展回合的系统审计显示,再利用缺陷普遍存在,并越发加深:物剂自见其历史代码,但却未能再利用(自我再利用衰减从83.9%降至69.1%,即使在饱和召回的情况下也是如此);通过第五轮审计,一半的任务链累积了交叉执行,而通过率几乎没有移动——以通过率为中心的评价完全看不到缺陷。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Coding agents are moving from research prototypes into real development workflows: new-generation models (e.g., Kimi K3 ( Team et al., 2026 ) , DeepSeek v4.1 ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) ) treat agentic coding as a core capability, while harnesses range from research frameworks (SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025a ) ) to industrial products (Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) , Codex ( OpenAI, 2025 ) , DeepSeek Harness ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) ).
It is increasingly clear that harness and interaction design have become performance variables on par with the backbone model ( Vats and Golev, 2026 ) :
SWE-agent highlights the role of tool-interface design, and Agentless ( Xia et al., 2024 ) shows that a simple localization–repair–validation pipeline is competitive even without an autonomous interaction loop.
Yet evaluation along this line is defined almost entirely by task success rate— how an agent writes code (whether it reuses existing implementations or piles up redundancy) is not measured. RepoReuse instead audits the reuse behavior of existing agents and harnesses.

编码剂正在从研究原型转向真正的开发工作流程:新一代模型(例如,Kimi K3(Team等人,2026年),DeepSeek v4.1(DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年))将代理编码视为核心能力,同时从研究框架(SWE代理(Yang等人,2024年),OpenHands(Wang等人,2025a年)到工业产品. (Claude Code(英语:Anthropic, 2025)),Codex(英语:OpenAI, 2025),DeepSeek Harness(英语:DeepSeek-AI, 2026).
日益明显的是,利用和互动设计已成为与主干模型相当的性能变量(Vats and Golev, 2026) :
SWE代理强调工具界面设计的作用,Agentless(Xia等人,2024年)显示,即使没有自主互动循环,简单的本地化-修复-验证管道也具有竞争力.
但沿着这条线进行的评价几乎完全由任务成功率来定义——一个代理写代码(无论是重新使用现有的执行还是堆积冗余)是如何不测量的. 反之,重新使用审计现有制剂和金属的再利用行为。

blocks.en:
Code generation evaluation has long centered on functional correctness, from function-level tests (HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , MBPP ( Austin et al., 2021 ) ) to issue resolution in real repositories (SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) ) and repository-level completion (CrossCodeEval ( Ding et al., 2023 ) , RepoBench ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , ML-Bench ( Tang et al., 2024 ) ).
Closest to us are multi-turn benchmarks: CodeFlowBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) iterates within a single file; MaintainCoder ( Wang et al., 2025b ) varies requirements but remains single-turn; SWE-Chain ( Lam et al., 2026 ) asks agents to upgrade a package step by step along its version chain, each step building on the agent’s own previous codebase; EvoCode-Bench ( Shen et al., 2026 ) and SWE-EVO ( Le et al., 2026 ) evaluate multi-turn iterative interaction and long-horizon version evolution under per-turn functional tests; LoopsBench ( Li et al., 2026 ) organizes each task as a dependency DAG with tests released along the ready frontier, observing bloated patches and prerequisite dependencies missed by agent plans; SlopCodeBench ( Orlanski et al., 2026 ) lets agents repeatedly extend their own solutions under evolving specifications, observing structural erosion and rising redundancy; SWE-Explore ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) measures line-level exploration recall, but over static snapshots with execution deliberately removed.
These works measure outcomes and artifacts, and none audits models’ reuse behavior in realistic repository-level multi-turn development. RepoReuse fills this gap: under a repository-level multi-turn iterative setting, it measures, turn by turn, an agent’s reuse of both pre-existing repository code and its own historical code.
blocks.zh:
代码生成评价长期以来一直以功能正确性为中心,从函数级测试(HumanEval(Chen等人,2021年),MBPP(Austin等人,2021年))到在真正的寄存器中发布解析(SWE-bench(Jimenez等人,2024年))和寄存器级完成. (CrossCodeEval(Ding等人,2023年),Repo Bench(刘等人,2023年),ML-Bench(Tang等人,2024年).
与我们最接近的是多回合基准: CodeFlow Bench(Wang等人,2026年)在一个文件内迭代;keep Coder(Wang等人,2025年b)要求不同,但仍是单转;SWE-Chain(Lam等人,2026年)请代理商沿其版本链逐级升级,每个步骤都建立在代理商自己之前的代码库上;EvoCode-Bench(Shen等人,2026年)和SWE-EVO(Le等人,2026年)在下转函数测试下评价多回合迭代相互作用和长弦版本的演变;Loops 法官(Li等人,2026年)将每一项任务作为依赖性DAG组织起来,在准备的边界沿线进行测试,观察布满的补丁和代理计划错过的先决条件依赖性;SlopCode Bench(Orlanski等人,2026年)让代理人在不断演变的规格下反复扩展自己的解决方案,观察结构侵蚀和不断增多的冗余;SWE-Expure(Zhang等人,2026年b)测量线级勘探召回,但在静态快照上故意去除.
这些工作衡量结果和文物,没有审计模式在现实的存储层多回合开发中的再利用行为。 RepoReuse填补了这个空白:在寄存器级的多回合迭代设置下,它依次测量一个代理对先前存在的寄存器代码和自身历史代码的再利用.

blocks.en: 3 RepoReuse
blocks.zh: 3 再使用

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准建设

blocks.en: Constructing RepoReuse requires delivering two things at once: multi-turn task chains, and a ground-truth answer to “what should be reused at each turn.” To this end, we implement a fully automatic construction pipeline: starting from mature open-source repositories, it produces tasks through three stages—evidence collection, task synthesis, and execution verification—without any human involvement. The pipeline guarantees that the reference solution genuinely reuses the designated modules and that the test cases come from actual execution, so that reuse auditing rests on verifiable ground truth.
blocks.zh: 构建再利用需要同时交付两件事情:多回合任务链和地面真实回答“每个回合应重新使用哪些东西 ” 。 为此,我们实施一个完全自动的建造管道:从成熟的开源储存库开始,它通过三个阶段——收集证据、综合任务和执行核查——产生任务,而没有任何人参与。 管道保证参考解决方案能够真正重新使用指定的模块,并且试验案例来自实际执行,因此再利用审计取决于可核实的地面真相。

blocks.en: RepoReuse builds its tasks on mature, widely used open-source Python libraries spanning domains such as scientific computing and data visualization. Selected repositories must satisfy three conditions: (1) a multi-file pure-Python codebase with a rich internal implementation layer beneath the public API—the evidence for our tasks comes from these undocumented internal subpackages rather than well-documented public interfaces; (2) a reproducible environment: each repository is pinned to a specific commit, and its dependency installation recipe is directly inherited from SWE-bench’s ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) install table, ensuring consistency between the construction and evaluation environments.
blocks.zh: RepoReuse将其任务建立在成熟,广泛使用的开源Python库之上,跨越科学计算和数据可视化等领域. 选定的储存库必须满足三个条件:(1) 多文件的纯Python编码库,在公共API下有一个丰富的内部执行层—— 我们任务的证据来自这些没有文件记录的内部分包,而不是有文件记录的公共接口;(2) 可复制的环境:每个储存库被固定在一个具体的承诺上,其依赖性的安装方法直接继承自SWE-bench的安装表(Jimenez等人,2024年),确保建筑与评价环境的一致性。

blocks.en: We first build a callable “map” of the repository: via AST-based static analysis, functions and methods are represented as nodes carrying precise line ranges, signatures, and docstrings, with call relations as edges, forming a dependency tree that covers the whole repository; internal symbols beneath the public API surface are marked as candidate starting points. A strong model (GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026 ) ) then performs guided walks over the dependency tree: starting from an internal symbol, it selects the next symbol hop by hop with justifications, collecting a group of interdependent modules as an evidence pack ( Li et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Walks from turn 2 onward depart from the previous turn’s artifact, making the reuse of earlier-turn functions a natural requirement of the task chain; to prevent evidence packs from degenerating into self-wrapping over turns, an additional nearby but previously unused repository symbol is injected during each walk.
blocks.zh: 我们首先构建一个可调用的寄存器“图”:通过基于AST的静态分析,函数和方法作为节点来表示,带有精确的行距,签名和docstrings,以呼号关系为边缘,形成覆盖整个寄存器的依赖树;公共API表面下的内部符号被标记为候选起点. 强大的模型(GPT-5.6 Sol(OpenAI, 2026))然后在依赖树上进行引导行走:从内部符号开始,它用理由跳来跳去选择下一个符号,收集一组相互依存的模块作为证据包(Li等人,2025a); Wu等人,2025年;Ma等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年a). 从第2转弯到第2转弯,与前转弯的文物不同,使早转弯功能的再利用成为任务链的自然要求;为了防止证据包在转弯过程中分解为自我包装,每次走弯期间会注入一个附近但以前未使用的附加寄存器符号.

blocks.en: Based on the evidence pack, the authoring model (GPT-5.6 Sol) synthesizes the complete content of a turn: (1) a requirement that describes only the target behavior and never names any evidence-pack symbol—otherwise exploration degenerates into a string search; (2) a reference solution that must genuinely call the evidence-pack modules and the chain’s previous-turn artifacts; (3) test cases whose expected values are taken from actual runs of the reference solution rather than the authoring model’s claimed outputs. Modules that pass verification are written back into the repository package under semantic names, side by side with real code, for later turns to depend on.
blocks.zh: 根据证据包,作者模型(GPT-5.6)综合了回合的全部内容:(1) 要求只描述目标行为,而绝不给任何证据包符号命名——否则勘探就退化为弦搜索;(2) 参考解决方案必须真正将证据包模块和链条的前转动文物称为参考;(3) 测试案例,其预期值取自参考解决方案的实际结果,而不是作者模型声称的产出。 通过校验的模块在语义名称下回写到寄存器包中,与真实代码并列,以便以后的转折依赖.

blocks.en: The core of verification is the reliability of the test cases themselves: every expected value is obtained by actually executing the reference solution, and cases that raise errors or produce unstable outputs are discarded; if too many are discarded for the remaining cases to cover the declared functions, the whole turn is regenerated. On top of this, each turn must pass automatic checks—e.g., the reference solution passes all tests, an empty implementation must fail, and AST analysis confirms that the reference solution genuinely reuses the evidence-pack modules. Finally, an independent audit, trusting none of the generator’s outputs, reinstalls the entire task chain and re-runs all tests before the task is packaged for delivery.
blocks.zh: 核查的核心是测试案例本身的可靠性:每个预期值都是通过实际执行参考解决方案获得的,引起错误或产生不稳定输出的案例会被丢弃;如果为剩余案例丢弃过多,无法覆盖所宣布的功能,则整个转折被重新生成. 除此之外,每个回合都必须通过自动检查——例如,参考解决方案通过所有测试,空执行必须失败,而AST分析证实,参考解决方案真正地重新使用证据包模块。 最后,独立审计,不信任发电机的任何产出,重新安装整个任务链,并在任务包装完成之前重新进行所有测试。

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
Since both the backbone model and the harness shape how an agent explores and writes code ( Vats and Golev, 2026 ) , we evaluate a grid of model–harness combinations. We use two representative harnesses: mini-SWE-agent ( SWE-agent Team, 2024 ) , a minimal harness whose only action is a bash command, and OpenCode ( Anomaly (2026), formerly SST ) , an open-source industrial harness with native read, grep, glob, edit, and write tools.
We pair them with four backbone models: GPT-5.6 Terra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-v4.1-flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.7-plus ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , and GLM-5.3 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
由于骨干模型和牵引力都塑造了特工如何探索和写代码(Vats and Golev, 2026年),我们评价一个模型的网格-harness组合. 我们使用两种具有代表性的绳索:一种是小型SWE代理(SWE代理团队,2024年),一种是最小的绳索,其唯一行动是bash命令;另一种是OpenCode(Anomaly (2026年),前身为SST),一种是开源的工业绳索,具有本土读物,grep, glob,编辑和写作工具.
我们用四个骨干模型来配对:GPT-5.6 Terra(OpenAI,2026年),DeepSeek-v4.1-flash(DeepSeek-AI等人,2026年),Quen3.7-plus(Quen Team,2026年),以及GLM-5.3(Z.ai,2026年).

blocks.en: All runs follow the self-invoking protocol: each turn starts a fresh agent session, while the workspace persists across turns and keeps the agent’s own earlier implementations; a failed turn does not end the chain. From turn 2 onward, the requirement lists the public interfaces of the functions the agent implemented in earlier turns but not their source code, and repository reuse targets are never named. All configurations share the same per-turn budget. All metrics are macro-averaged over turns where they are defined.
blocks.zh: 所有运行都遵循自引用的协议:每个转弯开始一个新的代理会话,而工作空间则持续跨转弯,并保持代理自身的早期执行;失败转弯不会结束链条. 从第2关开始,要求列出了先前转弯时执行的代理功能的公共接口,但不列出其源代码,寄存器再利用目标从未命名. 所有配置共享相同的每个回合的预算. 所有衡量标准都是宏观平均值,在界定的转弯处。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports overall results where we draw several core insight:
blocks.zh: 表2报告总体结果,我们从中得出若干核心见解:

blocks.en: No configuration reliably builds on existing code. Even the strongest misses 24.3% of repository targets and 13.6% of its own earlier functions, although the requirement explicitly lists these functions and encourages reusing them; Qwen3.7-plus misses about half of the repository targets and a third of the self targets under both harnesses, leave a substantial room for improvement.

blocks.en: On the repository side, reuse tracks upstream exploration. Configurations that view at least 900 source lines per turn reach 47–61% repository recall, while those viewing fewer than 700 lines reach only 35–42%, and targets that were read are consistently more likely to be reused than targets that were not. On the self side, reading is not the bottleneck: every configuration reads at least 98.9% of its own earlier targets, yet self reuse ranges only from 67.0% to 86.4%. The gap therefore lies in the decision to build on the code that was found, not in finding it.
blocks.zh: 在寄存器一侧,再利用跟踪上游探索. 每次浏览至少900条源线的配置可回溯到47-61%的寄存器,而观看不到700条源线的配置可回溯到35-42%,被读到的目标总是比没有的目标更容易被重用。 在自我方面,读取不是瓶颈:每个配置读取至少98.9%自己的早期目标,然而自我再利用范围只有67.0%到86.4%. 因此,差距在于决定以已发现的守则为基础,而不是找到守则。

blocks.en: Downstream, reuse first aligns with correctness. Configurations that reuse more repository code generally also resolve more turns and pass more tests: DeepSeek-v4.1-flash leads on both reuse and correctness, while Qwen3.7-plus trails on both. Reuse also aligns with structure. Targets that are bypassed are far more likely than reused ones to have their logic re-implemented, so the two DeepSeek-v4.1-flash configurations, which reuse the most, have clearly the lowest C dup C_{\text{dup}} at 17.1% and 21.1%, while all others lie between 33.6% and 46.7%. Across configurations, then, reuse, correctness, and redundancy move together; the following sections show that within a configuration, as turns progress or the memory changes, reuse and redundancy shift while pass rates barely move.
blocks.zh: 下游,再利用首先符合正确性. 重复使用更多寄存器代码的配置一般也会解决更多的转折,并通过更多的测试: DeepSeek-v4.1-flash在重复使用和正确性上都领先,而Quen3.7-plus在两者上都领先. 重复使用也符合结构。 被绕过的目标远比被重复使用的目标更可能重新实施其逻辑,因此两个重新使用最多的DeepSeek-v4.1-flash配置明显是最低的C dup C_{\text{dup}} ,分别是17.1%和21.1%,而其他的则在33.6%和46.7%之间. 然后跨配置,再利用,正确性和冗余性一起移动;以下各节显示,在配置内,随着转动进度或内存的改变,再利用和冗余转换,而通过率几乎不会移动.

Reuse, recall, correctness, and C dup C_{\text{dup}} are in %; agent behavior and C dup C_{\text{dup}} are averaged over turns. Best reuse, recall, and correctness per column in bold .
blocks.zh: 表4:历史记忆对OpenCode的影响,带有Quen3.7-plus(75个任务链,每设定375转). 重用、 召回、 正确, 以及 C dup C_{\text{ dup} 都在%; 代理行为和 C dup C_{\text{ dup} 平均在转弯处 。 每栏最佳再利用、召回和正确度用粗体表示。

blocks.zh: 表5:历史记忆对OpenCode的影响与Quen3.7-plus(%)。 自重用的定义从第2转弯;\\Delta是从第1转弯到最后转弯的改变.

blocks.en: 4.3 Reuse Across Turns
blocks.zh: 4.3 跨转弯重用

blocks.en: The aggregate results above average over all turns and hide how reuse evolves as a task chain grows. Since each turn adds the agent’s own code to the workspace, later turns offer more opportunities to reuse and, equally, to bypass existing implementations. Table 3 therefore compares the first and last turn of each task chain.
blocks.zh: 总体结果高于平均值,并掩盖了随着任务链的增长,再利用是如何演变的。 由于每次转动都会将代理商自己的代码添加到工作空间中,后来转动会提供更多的重用机会,同样也为绕过现有的执行提供了更多的机会. 因此,表3比较了每个任务链的第一个和最后一个回合。

blocks.en: As task chains progress, agents build less on existing code. Self reuse drops by 8–24 points from turn 2 to the last turn in every configuration, even though the requirement keeps listing the agent’s earlier functions. The decline is steepest for Qwen3.7-plus, which loses 23–24 points, about twice the 10–13 points lost by DeepSeek-v4.1-flash.
blocks.zh: 随着任务链的进展,代理商对现有代码的依赖较少. 自我再利用从每个配置的转弯2到最后一个转弯下降了8–24分,即使要求继续列出剂的早期功能. 下降幅度对Qwen3.7-plus最陡峭,损失23–24分,约为DeepSeek-v4.1-flash损失的10–13分的两倍.

blocks.en: On the repository side, the decline in reuse follows the collapse of exploration. Agents read 76–91% of repository targets at turn 1, but repository recall drops sharply once their own earlier code is available, reaching only 16–51% by the last turn. Reuse falls far less than recall, so later-turn repository reuse is increasingly made without reading the target, plausibly from call sites seen in the agent’s own earlier code. Self targets show the opposite pattern: recall stays saturated in every turn, so the decline in self reuse cannot be attributed to exploration.
blocks.zh: 在储存库方面,再利用的下降是随着勘探的崩溃而发生的. 代理在第一回合读取了76–91 %的寄存器目标,但一旦有了自己的早期代码,寄存器召回率就急剧下降,到最后一回合时只达到16–51 %. 重复使用比回忆要少得多,所以后转寄存器的重复使用越来越多地在不读目标的情况下进行,从代理商自己较早的代码中看到的呼叫站点看来是可信的. 自我目标显示出相反的规律:每次召回都保持饱和,所以自我再利用的下降不能归因于勘探.

blocks.en: The decline in reuse has a structural consequence. When agents stop building on existing code, they re-implement it: targets that are bypassed are far more likely than reused ones to have their logic rewritten in the submission. Accordingly, C dup C_{\text{dup}} grows steadily over turns in every configuration, from 9–21% of task chains at turn 1 to 51–69% by the last turn; only DeepSeek-v4.1-flash, which retains the most self reuse, stays at 25–33%. Because each turn inherits the workspace left by earlier turns, these re-implementations persist, leaving parallel versions of the same logic scattered across modules. None of this is visible in pass rates.
blocks.zh: 复用量的下降产生了结构性后果。 当物剂停止在现有代码的基础上发展时,它们会重新执行它:被绕过的目标比被再利用的目标更有可能在提交书中重写其逻辑. 因此,C dup C_{\text{dup}}}在每一个配置的转弯上稳步增长,从第1转弯时的9–21%的任务链到最后转弯时的51–69 %;只有DeepSeek-v4.1-flash,它保留了最多的自我再利用,仍然保持在25–33%。 由于每个转弯都继承了先前转弯留下的工作空间,这些重实施持续,使得同一逻辑的平行版本分散在模块中. 这些都不是通过率所见。

blocks.en: 4.4 Effect of Historical Memory
blocks.zh: 4.4 历史记忆的影响

blocks.en: In multi-turn development, what an agent is told about its earlier work may shape whether it builds on that work ( Packer et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . We therefore vary the form of historical memory in the requirement while keeping everything else fixed, using OpenCode with Qwen3.7-plus. Under all three settings, the agent’s own earlier implementations remain in the workspace; only the requirement differs from turn 2 onward: • No memory : the requirement contains no information about earlier turns. • Interface memory (our default): the requirement lists the module, name, signature, return value, and behavior of each function implemented in earlier turns, and encourages reusing them. • Source memory : the requirement includes the complete source code of every earlier submission, verbatim.
blocks.zh: 在多回合开发中,其早期工作的代理人被告知的内容可能决定它是否以这项工作为基础(Packer等人,2024年;Li等人,2025年b); 张等, 2024. ). 因此,我们在要求中改变了历史记忆的形式,同时保留其他一切固定,使用OpenCode与Quen3.7-plus. 在所有三种情况下,代理商自己的早期执行仍然停留在工作空间;只有要求与转向2不同: 无内存 : 要求中没有关于先前转弯的信息 。 · 接口内存(我们的默认):要求列出模块,名称,签名,返回值,以及较早转折时执行的每个函数的行为,并鼓励重用. • 来源内存:要求包括以前提交的每份逐字记录的完整来源代码。

blocks.en: No memory : the requirement contains no information about earlier turns.
blocks.zh: 无内存 : 要求中没有关于先前转弯的信息 。

blocks.en: Interface memory (our default): the requirement lists the module, name, signature, return value, and behavior of each function implemented in earlier turns, and encourages reusing them.
blocks.zh: 界面内存(our default):要求列出了模块,名称,签名,返回值,以及较早时执行的每个函数的行为,并鼓励重用.

blocks.en: Source memory : the requirement includes the complete source code of every earlier submission, verbatim.
blocks.zh: 来源内存 : 要求包括每份先前提交的完整来源代码,逐字记录.

blocks.en: Table 4 reports overall results under each memory setting, and Table 5 compares their first and last turns.
blocks.zh: 表4报告每个内存设置的总体结果,表5比较了第一次和最后一次。

blocks.en: To get agents to build on their own earlier code, a short description of what already exists works, while handing them the complete source does not. Listing the interfaces of earlier functions raises self reuse from 30.0% with no memory to 67.8%, more than doubling it. Supplying the full source of earlier submissions instead leaves self reuse at 29.2%, no better than giving no memory at all, and it stays flat at about 29% in every turn. More information about earlier work is thus not what agents need; what helps is a compact map of which functions exist and where to find them. Interface memory mitigates rather than removes the problem, however: self reuse still declines over turns, from 82.9% to 58.9%. Note also that interface memory explicitly encourages reuse while source memory does not, so the two factors cannot be fully separated.
blocks.zh: 为了让特工们建立自己早期的代码,对已经存在的东西作一个简短的描述,同时将完整的源头交给他们是不起作用的. 列出先前函数的接口,将自再利用率从没有内存的30.0%提高到67.8%,翻了一番以上. 提供先前提交材料的全部来源,使自我再利用率保持在29.2%,并不比完全不提供记忆好,而且每回都保持约29%的水平。 因此,更多关于早期工作的信息不是代理人需要什么;需要帮助的是一张关于存在哪些职能和在哪里找到这些职能的简明地图。 然而,界面内存减轻了问题,而不是消除了问题:自用率在转弯后仍然下降,从82.9%下降到58.9%。 也请注意,界面内存在源内存没有的情况下明确鼓励再利用,因此这两个因素无法完全分离.

blocks.en: Without memory, agents explore the workspace more broadly, opening 27.7 files per turn, about twice the 13.5 opened under interface memory, which raises repository recall from 35.1% to 55.5% and repository reuse from 50.5% to 58.9%. With interface memory, they rely on the note rather than exploring, and repository recall collapses twice as fast over turns, losing 61.6 points against 30.5 without memory. Memory thus shifts reuse between sources: it strengthens reuse of the agent’s own code but partly at the expense of repository code that the note does not cover.
blocks.zh: 没有内存,代理对工作空间进行更广泛的探索,每转弯打开27.7个文件,大约是接口内存打开的13.5个文件的两倍,这使得寄存器召回率从35.1%提高到55.5%,寄存器再利用率从50.5%提高到58.9%。 与界面内存相比,他们依靠注释而不是探索,寄存器在转弯时的倒塌率是倒塌率的两倍,与没有内存的30.5相比,损失了61.6分. 因此,内存在来源之间转移了再利用:它加强了对制剂自身代码的再利用,但部分牺牲了说明未涵盖的存储码。

blocks.en: Correctness is nearly identical across the three settings, with resolved rates of 27.7–30.4% and passed rates of 70.2–72.4%, yet their reuse behavior differs sharply. Redundancy is lowest under interface memory, where C dup C_{\text{dup}} is 46.7%, and highest under source memory, where it reaches 70.7%: with the full source of earlier turns in context, agents tend to rewrite its logic rather than import it, and by the last turn 94.7% of task chains contain a re-implemented target. As in the main results, a pass-rate-centered evaluation would treat these settings as equivalent, even though they leave very different workspaces behind.
blocks.zh: 这三个环境的正确性几乎相同,解决率为27.7–30.4%,通过率为70.2–72.4%,然而它们的再利用行为却大不相同。 在接口内存下冗余度最低,C dup C_{\text{dup}}}为46.7%,在源内存下冗余度最高,达到70.7%:在上下文中,由于先前转动的全部来源,代理往往会重写其逻辑而非导入,到最后转动时,94.7%的任务链包含重执行的目标. 与主要结果一样,以通过率为中心的评价会将这些设置视为等效,尽管它们留下了非常不同的工作空间.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We asked a question existing evaluation cannot answer— do coding agents reuse existing code or reinvent the wheel? We built RepoReuse to make it measurable: a multi-turn benchmark on real repositories in which requirements are revealed turn by turn, the workspace accumulates across turns, and reuse of both pre-existing repository modules and the agent’s own historical code is audited per turn. The benchmark is produced by a fully automated pipeline and scales readily to new repositories. The answer it gives is sobering: agents progressively stop exploring the repository they work in; they reuse their own history less even when it is fully in view, and handing them the complete source does not help; and the targets they bypass accumulate as cross-turn duplication that pass rates never register. Agents can solve every task and still degrade the codebase and pass rates cannot tell the difference. We hope RepoReuse provides a sustainable instrument for auditing, and ultimately improving, how agents build on existing code.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个现有评价不能回答的问题——编码剂是重新使用现有编码还是重新发明轮子? 我们建造了RepoReuse以使它可以衡量:一个真实储存库的多回合基准,其中要求依次显示,工作空间跨次累积,对先前存在的储存库模块和代理商自身历史代码的再利用情况逐次审计。 基准由一个完全自动化的管道和可方便地进入新储存库的尺度编制。 它给出的答案是清醒的:物剂逐渐停止探索它们工作的寄存器;即使完全看到它们自己的历史,它们也会减少重复使用它们的历史,而把完整的来源交给它们也无济于事;它们所绕过的目标由于交叉重复而累积,而通过率从未登记。 特工可以解决每一项任务,仍然可以降解代码库,通过率也无法分辨区别. 我们希望再利用为审计和最终改进代理人如何在现有守则的基础上发展提供了一个可持续的工具。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: RepoReuse currently covers five mature, pure-Python libraries and 75 five-turn task chains, evaluated with two harnesses and four backbone models; whether the observed deficiencies generalize to other languages, domains, and longer development horizons remains open. Widening the repository pool and the model–harness grid is work in progress, and the fully automated construction pipeline makes both straightforward to extend.
blocks.zh: RepoReuse目前涵盖5个成熟的纯Python图书馆和75个五转式任务链,通过两个牵引器和四个骨干模型进行评估;所观察到的缺陷是否概括到其他语言,域,以及较长的开发视野仍然开放. 正在扩大储存库和模型-热电网,完全自动化的施工管道使两者都能够直接延伸。

blocks.zh: 附 录

blocks.en: Appendix A Experimental Setup Details
blocks.zh: 附录 A 实验设置细节

blocks.en: A.1 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.1 评价议定书

blocks.en: Each task chain runs in its own workspace, and its turns are executed in order. Before turn t t , the workspace contains the original repository together with every file the agent submitted in turns 1 , … , t − 1 1,\dots,t-1 , each at its required module path; reference solutions never enter the workspace. At each turn, the requirement is rendered according to the memory setting (Appendix A.3 ) and handed to a fresh agent session with no dialogue history, trajectory, or test feedback from earlier turns. When the agent stops, whether by finishing, exhausting its budget, or failing, we read back whatever file exists at the required path and score it. A turn without a file at that path fails all of its tests. The hidden tests are copied into the workspace only after the agent stops, run from a temporary directory with a 600-second timeout, and removed afterwards. A failed turn does not end the chain: the next turn starts from whatever the agent actually left behind.
blocks.zh: 每个任务链在自己的工作空间运行,其转弯按顺序执行. 在 t t 转弯前, 工作空间包含原始寄存器和代理在 1 转弯, ..., t − 1 ,\ dots, t 1 中提交的每个文件, 每个文件都在其所需的模块路径上; 引用解决方案从不进入工作空间 。 每次回合,要求都按照内存设置(Appendix A.3 )进行,并交给一个新鲜的代理会话,没有对话历史,轨迹,也没有测试早先回合的反馈. 当代理停止,无论是通过完成,耗尽其预算,还是失败,我们读回任何文件在所需路径上存在,并评分. 在那个路径上没有文件的转弯失败了所有测试. 隐藏的测试只有在代理停止后才会复制到工作空间,从临时目录中运行,超时600秒,然后删除. 失败的转弯不会结束链条: 下一个转弯从代理机实际留下的任何东西开始.

blocks.en: Before the first turn, we remove information that would let the agent bypass exploration. Git history is deleted, since git log would expose later changes. All test files are deleted file by file, including test_*.py , conftest.py , and cached test listings, because repository tests are where the construction pipeline found its evidence and often spell out the conventions a task relies on. Test runners and helpers that the package imports at runtime are kept, and we verify that the package still imports after this step.
blocks.zh: 在第一个回合之前,我们删除信息 让特工绕过探索。 Git历史被删除,因为git日志会暴露以后的变化. 所有测试文件都是通过文件删除的,包括 testá.py, conftest.py,以及缓存的测试列表,因为存储器测试是构建管道找到其证据的地方,并且经常阐明一个任务所依赖的常规. 测试跑步者和帮助者, 包的进口在运行时间得到保持, 我们核实, 包的进口在此步骤之后。

blocks.en: Each repository is pinned to its benchmark commit and installed in editable mode in a dedicated conda environment, following the installation recipe of SWE-bench ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . The same environment is used by all configurations, so that differences between runs come only from the agent.
blocks.zh: 每一个存放处都遵循SWE-bench的安装配方(Jimenez等人,2024年),在专用conda环境中被固定在基准承诺上并以可编辑的方式安装。 所有配置都使用相同的环境,因此运行之间的差异只来自代理.

blocks.en: A.2 Harness and Model Configuration
blocks.zh: A.2 合理性和模型配置

blocks.en: Table 6: Per-turn budgets and settings of the two harnesses.
blocks.zh: 表6:两机的每轮预算和设置。

blocks.en: The agent interacts with the repository only through bash commands, each executed in a fresh subshell. Its prompt is adapted from the harness’s default template with our delivery instructions (Appendix A.3 ). We make one addition to the default observation template: each observation reports how many commands have been used, since without it agents tended to spend the whole budget exploring and submit nothing. The agent ends a turn with an explicit submit command. Table 6 lists its budgets; a turn is also stopped after three consecutive malformed responses.
blocks.zh: 代理仅通过bash命令与寄存器进行交互,每个命令在一个新的子目录中执行. 它的速率是根据我们的发送指示(Appendix A.3 ), 我们在默认的观察模板中增加了一个:每个观察报告使用了多少命令,因为如果没有它,代理人往往花掉整个预算来探索和提交任何文件。 代理以明确的提交命令结束一转. 表6列出了其预算;在连续三次答复不当之后,也停止了转弯。

blocks.en: We run OpenCode in its headless mode with external plugins disabled and every tool call auto-approved. Each run uses an isolated configuration with a single model provider, so that no user-level settings, plugins, or agents affect the run. OpenCode has no built-in step or cost limit, so each turn is bounded only by the 2,400-second wall time. All models are accessed through the same OpenAI-compatible gateway under both harnesses.
blocks.zh: 我们以无头模式运行 OpenCode, 外部插件已禁用, 每个工具都使用自动调用 。 每次运行都使用一个孤立的配置,只有一个模型提供者,因此没有用户级的设置,插件,或代理影响运行. OpenCode没有内置阶梯或成本限制,因此每个转弯仅以2400秒的墙壁时间为界. 所有模型都通过同一OpenAI兼容的网关在两种带下访问.

blocks.en: Agent errors, timeouts, and exceeded budgets are not retried. As described above, the turn is scored on whatever file the agent left at the required path, so such failures count against correctness rather than being excluded.
blocks.zh: 代理错误、超时和超出预算的情况不再重审。 如上所述,该转弯在代理在所需路径上留下的任意文件上都得分,因此这种失败算不上正确性,而不是被排除在外.

blocks.en: A.3 Requirement and Memory Formats
blocks.zh: A.3 要求和内存格式

blocks.en: Every requirement follows the same structure: a behavioral description of the task, the exact path and importable module name of the file to create, and for each required function its signature, a description of its behavior, and a precise contract for its return value. From turn 2 onward, a historical note follows, whose form depends on the memory setting. Repository reuse targets are never named in the requirement.
blocks.zh: 每个要求都遵循相同的结构:对任务的行为描述,创建文件的确切路径和可导入模块名称,以及每个需要的函数的签名,对其行为的描述,以及返回值的精确合同. 从2号转弯开始,后面是历史注释,其形式取决于记忆设置. 仓库再利用目标在要求中从未命名.

blocks.en: Both harnesses wrap the requirement in the same delivery instructions, shown in Appendix B.2 for OpenCode; mini-SWE-agent uses the same wording within its own action protocol. These instructions are identical across all memory settings, so a generic encouragement to reuse existing code is present even when the historical note is removed or replaced.
blocks.zh: 两者都将要求包裹在同一送货指令中,如OpenCode的附录B.2所示;微型SWE代理在其自己的动作协议中使用相同的措辞. 这些指令在所有内存设置中都是相同的,因此即使历史注释被移除或替换,也存在对重复使用现有代码的通用鼓励.

blocks.en: The three memory settings of Section 4.4 differ only in the historical note. No memory removes the note entirely. Interface memory , our default, lists for every earlier turn its module and, for each function, its signature, return contract, and behavior, and encourages reusing them. Source memory removes the interface note and instead embeds the exact source file submitted in each earlier turn, delimited by markers and labeled with its path. The box in Appendix B.2 shows the interface-memory note for turn 2 of a seaborn task, whose first turn implemented three color-mapping functions.

blocks.en: Figures 2 and 3 show two consecutive turns of one task chain (mini-SWE-agent with DeepSeek-v4.1-flash). At turn 4, the agent implements center_within_groups , which centers a numeric column within seaborn’s categorical groups, and passes all tests. At turn 5, the requirement asks for per-category summaries of centered values and explicitly lists the turn-4 interface. The agent reads the turn-4 source in full (recall = 1.0 =1.0 ), yet never imports it. Instead, it rewrites the dtype coercion, group masking, categorical ordering, and mean-centering logic from scratch in 262 lines, where the ground truth solution reaches the same behavior in 68 lines by calling the turn-4 function and aggregating its output. The submission passes 10/10 tests: nothing in the pass rate registers that the workspace now hosts two parallel implementations of the same centering semantics.
